# 1 Enoch Chapter 34 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of Watchers

---

**34:1** And from there I went toward the north to the ends of the earth, and there I saw a great and glorious device at the ends of the whole earth.

**34:2** And there I saw three portals of heaven open in the heaven; through each of them proceed north winds: when they blow there is cold, hail, frost, snow, dew, and rain.

**34:3** And out of one portal they blow for good, but when they blow through the other two portals it is with violence and affliction on the earth, and they blow with violence.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus rendering adjudicated from EMET (literal), LOGOS (formal), and PNEUMA (dynamic). Chapter 34 describes the three northern heavenly portals: one produces beneficial weather; two produce violent weather. This brief chapter forms the northern section of the four-directional portal sequence concluding the second cosmic journey (chs. 33-36).*
